basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old dog lover from Portland, Oregon, currently working as a freelance graphic designer. I'm fascinated by the intersection of science and psychedelics, which led me to explore subreddits like LSD. I don't have aphantasia myself, but I'm interested in how different brains perceive experiences. When I'm not working or online, I enjoy hiking with my Cane Corso, Maximus. I'm single and generally online during the late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, which developed my keen interest in visual experiences and perception. My knowledge about psychedelics is mostly self-taught, fueled by reading articles and participating in online discussions. I also actively research topics related to my work, such as digital design trends.
